interpretation: Frozen CUDA index_add_ reduction order varies independently per block. Matching the original sampling schedule preserves the distribution of charts. Independent native forwards, including two runs of the frozen source, can violate the strict FP64 tolerance.

Fixed-sum and complete-table comparisons use exactly the same ordered neighbors, the original three per-block draws and weights. The native operator control uses the original frame, projection and interpolation operations on detached inputs within the remaining compiled model.

A lookup-table disagreement in FP32 does not establish an end-to-end tolerance failure. Raw native and compiled observations, controlled table replays, and unavailable measurements have distinct meanings.

method.chart_only: Original block-specific sums, edge vectors, source edges and query edges were captured from the frozen CUDA forward. The three geometry calls produce local frames, rotate original directions and return four interpolation corners/weights. Compare a native call and a true fullgraph Inductor call on the same tensors, per block.
method.sums: Inject those three distinct sums only. Keep the 29a20ac model and its own sphere projection under ordinary torch.compile. The detached observation operator records the actual tables consumed inside the model.
method.tables: Inject all three complete frozen native interpolation tables. The following message and readout, E/F and E-squared plus F-squared training loss run normally. Active gradient names, shapes, dtypes and tolerances are checked.
method.native-op: On the same fixed receiver sums, wrap only the three detached original geometry calls in a native CUDA operator during torch.compile. Feed the resulting tables through the same compiled message model. Production df32e34 dispatches the identical native geometry arithmetic within sphere_projection for CUDA float64.

int32_graph_metadata.input: Explicit, nonempty int32 source and query maps with float64 vectors. Native interpolation produces long indices. The 59bd0d4 follow-up preserves this output type during tracing.
